source.title: Set Codex app-server model and reasoning explicitly in Symphony
source.objective: Ensure any Symphony/Codex app-server integration sets model and reasoning via config overrides and verifies the actual thread settings, rather than relying on -m.

work_item_evidence.value_json: {"chat_url": null, "code_location": null, "description": "Symphony/Codex app-server model selection pitfall: invoking codex with -m gpt-5.6-terra app-server did not set the app-server thread model in the real canary; the resulting rollout used gpt-6-sol medium from global config. codex doctor confirms that -c model=gpt-5.6-terra -c model_reasoning_effort=medium correctly overrides the invocation config.
